roll.evidence: Fujifilm lists 10.2 cm / 4 inch rolls among several widths; user confirmed 10.2 cm, not 12.7 cm. It is not the only standard width.

heater_candidates.name: Lucky Reptile Thermo Mat PRO HTP-20
heater_candidates.verification: Amazon.de product option selected: 20 Watt; product table HTP-20, 20 Watt = ca. 35 x 20 cm, ASIN B0044MPIZM. The page title remained the 10 W parent listing, so use selected option and product table.
heater_candidates.proposed_use: Selected: one flat shared 20 W mat behind the metal spreader. Prewarm mixing water to roughly 35-38 C. Measure actual bath temperatures after settling and use the user's established experimental timing. No fixed temperature guarantee.

heater_candidates.name: Lucky Reptile Thermo Mat PRO HTP-10
heater_candidates.proposed_use: Comparison candidate. Two separate units need larger external mounting faces than the vessel bodies; do not bend them around a vessel.

facts: Specified uncovered surface temperature at room temperature is approximately 36 to 42 C, not a regulated bath temperature.
The manufacturer recommends a thermostat and prohibits bending the mat.
Protect the mat from damage, keep connections dry, do not immerse, and permit heat dissipation.
The overheat breaker is an emergency protection, not a temperature controller.

rejected_options.name: Exo Terra Heat Mat 8 W PT2016
rejected_options.reason: Manufacturer specifies glass terrariums only, and the 200 x 200 mm size does not fit a vessel face directly.

rejected_options.name: HabiStat standard heat mats
rejected_options.reason: 4 W 127 x 102 mm has limited heating area/power; 7 W 150 x 280 mm is too tall for direct mounting. Mat Stat's 18-34 C range is below the desired nominal 35 C.

remaining: Measure actual mat thickness before printing the fittings; nominal 3 mm is adjustable.
Physical water-tightness, wet-paper movement, contact pressure, filling and temperature tests remain outstanding.
thermostat: Omitted at user request, 2026-10-20. No permanent probe or probe fitting. Manufacturer recommends a thermostat; this prototype uses the user's manually measured equilibrium workflow.

chemistry.name: ADOX RA-4 2.5 litre kit
chemistry.nominal_process: 35 C, 45 seconds developer and bleachfix; manufacturer specifies developer 35 +/- 0.3 C. User explicitly chooses their previously tested temperature/time experiment instead.
chemistry.planning: 325 ml per bath / 102 x 208 mm whole cut = 30 whole prints rounded down. Do not add A and B capacities; every print passes both baths. Test strips count.
chemistry.storage: Manufacturer: opened concentrate within two months; working solution up to one month in completely filled tightly closed bottles. Open processor storage is not covered by this statement.
